Source snapshot: DMs Revenue Flow public investor page, https://dmrevenueflow.com/
Snapshot date: 2026-05-21

The market section says DMs Revenue Flow is pursuing 6 validated verticals.

The market section says total TAM is $500B+ in global digital marketing.

The pitch names adjacent AI video and multimodal tools including HeyGen, Runway, Kling, Sora, GPT-4o, and Claude 3.5 Sonnet.

The public source names these products as examples of mainstream AI video or multimodal-model tools.

Public evidence therefore does not support the overbroad claim that there are no direct or adjacent competitors in AI video, multimodal content, or DM automation.

The pitch does not include a bottom-up calculation proving the $500B+ TAM from customer counts, ACV, penetration, or conversion rates.
